mapvxFloors.note: MapVX floor ids (InnerFloor.key) per catalog floor label. Pass them as destination-floor-id: a place on several floors (an elevator) otherwise routes to its FIRST floor, the Nivel -1 car park. Careful: MapVX level -2 is named 'Nivel -1' and level -1 is named 'Planta Baja' (our PB).
